criteria.label: Scientific plausibility
criteria.asks: Is every depicted structure biologically/chemically plausible and consistent with the locked manuscript? Any malformed anatomy, duplicated organs, impossible morphology, invented structures, or animal-cell features in a plant cell?

criteria.label: Faithfulness to the intended concept
criteria.asks: Does the image teach the ONE idea named in Educational Purpose? Did it follow the composition, panel count and visual type in the prompt? Anything required that is missing?

criteria.label: Label-zone discipline / no authoritative AI text
criteria.asks: Is the art free of typeset scientific text, garbled pseudo-Latin, invented axes, numbers, gene names or units? Are clean callout zones reserved for the manual labels listed in the tracker? This is a hard project rule: generated text is never authoritative.

criteria.label: Composition and visual hierarchy
criteria.asks: Does one primary idea read first? Is there generous negative space, safe margins, no critical element cropped, no clutter competing for attention?

criteria.label: Print readability
criteria.asks: At the intended page treatment and aspect ratio, does it hold up in print? Sufficient edge precision, contrast and detail separation; no mush, no artefacting.

criteria.label: Consistency with the book's visual system
criteria.asks: Restrained botanical greens/deep forest/cream/muted gold on light neutral ground; clean scientific-illustration finish. No recreational-cannabis cliches, smoke, neon dispensary aesthetics, novelty graphics.

criteria.label: Strong enough to show Manny
criteria.asks: Would you put this in front of the author as representative of the book's quality, or would it cost credibility?

verdict_rules.REGENERATE: Any hard-gate criterion scores <= 2, OR scientific_plausibility <= 3, OR concept_fidelity <= 2. The draft is structurally wrong; rewrite the prompt and regenerate rather than micro-edit.
verdict_rules.REVISE: All criteria >= 3 but at least one hard gate is unmet. The draft is mostly right; apply a targeted edit.
verdict_rules.PASS_WITH_MINOR_NOTES: All hard gates met and weighted score >= 0.75 but < 0.85, or a non-blocking note is recorded. Usable; carries notes into layout.
verdict_rules.PASS: All hard gates met and weighted score >= 0.85.

stoplight.GREEN: PASS or PASS_WITH_MINOR_NOTES with no open scientific-verification flag. Ready for Manny.
stoplight.YELLOW: PASS_WITH_MINOR_NOTES, or any verdict carrying an open scientific/data-verification flag. Usable but needs notes.
stoplight.RED: REVISE, REGENERATE, blocked on a decision, or cycle cap reached. Not ready.
